_comment: Version schedule + effort estimates · source of truth for schedule.js · the Gantt view in the WIKI renders this · keep ROADMAP.md as the human narrative (themes/goals), this file holds the structured dates + dependencies

versions.title: example version
versions._note_milestone: the version's target release date · rendered as a diamond marker + vertical line in the Gantt · omit if the version has no fixed date

items.title: example task
items._note_estimate: estimated effort in working days · not calendar days · solo devs: be honest, pad for unknowns
items._note_dependsOn: item ids that must finish before this can start · empty array = no deps
items._note_confidence: high = sure of the estimate · low = wild guess, will likely slip · Gantt renders low-confidence bars with a dashed outline

items.title: follow-up task depending on the first

versions.title: version without a fixed date
versions._note_no_milestone: no milestone field · Gantt shows it as an open-ended group, bars laid out by sequence not calendar

items.title: sequential task (no dates, order inferred from dependsOn)
